title: Copilot Studio: improvements to the agent evaluations experience
summary: The roadmap facts, credit model, data-policy control and capacity-management operations are supported, including both API operations questioned by the pre-check. The briefing passes with a minor governance-table gap: its consumption-review checklist step has no corresponding reporting row.

claims.claim: Add-ConnectorsToPolicy supports PolicyName, Classification Blocked and Connectors, with connector objects carrying id, type and name.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Blocking the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector prevents authenticated automated evaluation runs and event triggers in the policy's environments.
claims.quote: To prevent agent makers from adding event triggers to their agents or running automated evaluations by using an authenticated account, configure a data policy that blocks the Microsoft Copilot Studio connector.

claims.claim: Environment tenant-pool draw is configured under Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant > Save.
claims.quote: select Licensing. ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment. ... Under Capacity overages, clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant. ... Select Save.

claims.claim: PUT licensing/allocationsV2 using version 2024-10-01 accepts the printed environment scope, MCSMessages allocation quantity and disabled TenantPool enforcement rule.
claims.quote: All programmatic examples in this article use API version 2024-10-01. ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"

claims.claim: Capacity management requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: A published environment-group rule governing tenant draw causes attempted individual-environment overrides to fail with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: Turning off tenant-pool draw does not prevent continued consumption through a linked pay-as-you-go plan.
claims.quote: If the environment is linked to a pay-as-you-go billing plan, usage can continue through the linked Azure subscription.

claims.claim: An agent monthly limit and Stop usage are configured under Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit > Stop usage > Save.
claims.quote: go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Agents. ... Select the agent, and then select Set limit. ... Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit. ... Select Save.

claims.claim: The general environment-resource threshold API supports the printed PUT path, version 2024-10-01 and limit/stopIfOverCapacity request body.
claims.quote: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/entitlements/{entitlementId}/resources/{resourceId}/threshold?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits are not applied instantly, and an agent can continue responding after reaching its limit.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: Agent sharing is opened through Share in the agent's three-dots menu in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: Open the agent and select the three dots (...) > Share.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center Licensing > Copilot Studio pages provide agent-level consumption monitoring.
claims.quote: Use the Copilot Studio licensing pages in the Power Platform admin center to review consumption at multiple levels: ... Agent: Review month-to-date billed credits, configured limits, and agent status.
